title: Give your computer's Claude a job from your phone

steps.title: What we'll do today
steps.html:
You'll control Claude Code on your computer from your phone. The feature is called Remote Control.

Your files stay on your computer; the phone is just the remote. You can give the Claude on your computer a job from your phone, even when you're out.

  • Time: 10–15 minutes
  • You need: a computer that finished Desktop 1, and a phone
  • While you use it, keep the computer on and the desktop app open
This practice uses both the computer and the phone. You can keep this page on either one.

faq.a: For Team and Enterprise accounts, an admin has to turn this feature on. Personal Pro and Max accounts can use it right away.

faq.q: Can I use it with just a phone, no computer?
faq.a: Yes! With a GitHub repository, Claude works in the cloud even when your computer is off. Set it up in Phone 2 and try it in Phone 3.

steps.title: Get the Claude app on your phone
steps.html:
If you already have it, just check you're signed in. Installing works the same as in Practice 0.

  1. Search for Claude in the App Store (iPhone) or Play Store. Check the maker is Anthropic.
  2. Install it and sign in with the same account as your computer.

check.q: Are you signed in to the Claude phone app with the same account?

steps.title: If the phone app doesn't work
steps.html:
• Not sure which account the computer uses? Click your name at the bottom left of the computer app to check.
  • If you signed up with Google, tap Continue with Google on the phone too.

steps.title: Get a Code conversation ready on the computer
steps.html:
1. Open the Claude app on your computer and click the Code tab.
  2. Click + New at the top left to start a new conversation.
  3. Check that the buttons under the typing box show Local · Practice · Manual.

check.q: Can you see Local · Practice · Manual under the typing box?

steps.title: If the computer side doesn't work
steps.html:
• Choosing the folder works like 'Choose the folder to work in' in Desktop 1.
  • Click the permission mode button and choose Manual.

steps.title: Turn on Remote Control on the computer
steps.html:
Type the text below in the computer's box and press Enter (return on a Mac).

Things that start with / (slash) aren't requests to Claude; they're commands that control the app.
steps.alt: Typing /remote-control in the computer app's box

check.q: Did you see a sign that Remote Control is on?

steps.title: If /remote-control doesn't work
steps.html:
• It only works in a Local (your computer) conversation. Check the button under the box says Local.
  • Make sure / is the very first thing in the box.
  • Update the app to the latest version. With a work account, ask your admin.

steps.title: Open that conversation on your phone
steps.html:
1. In the Claude phone app, tap Code in the menu.
  2. Tap the conversation with a computer icon and a green dot.

The green dot means "connected to your computer".
steps.alt: Tapping the computer conversation with a green dot in the phone's Code list

check.q: Did the conversation open on your phone?

steps.title: If it isn't in the phone's list
steps.html:
• Check the phone and computer use the same account.
  • Pull the list down to refresh.
  • No green dot? The computer is off or asleep. Wake it up and keep the app open.

steps.title: Give it a job from your phone
steps.html:
Paste or type the sentence below into the phone's box and send it.

Just like on the computer, a permission card appears on your phone. When the green line shows + 4. Buy milk, tap Allow.

Allowing on your phone changes files on your computer. Even on a small screen, read the red and green lines before you tap.
steps.alt: Checking the permission card on the phone and tapping Allow

check.q: Did you tap Allow on your phone?

steps.title: If no permission card appears
steps.html:
• Claude may still be thinking. Wait a few seconds.
  • If it already says it added it, the mode may not be Manual. Switch it to Manual in the computer app.
  • If it says todo.txt doesn't exist, check the computer conversation's folder is Practice.

steps.title: Check on the computer
steps.html:
Open todo.txt in the practice folder on your computer. Buy milk is on the last line.

What you asked from your phone went straight into the file on your computer.
steps.alt: Checking in Notepad on the computer that Buy milk was added

check.q: Do you see 'Buy milk' in todo.txt on the computer?

steps.title: If it's not in the file
steps.html:
• If Notepad was already open, close it and open it again.
  • In the phone conversation, ask "Show me what todo.txt says now."

steps.title: When you finish, and next time
steps.html:
• If you close the app or turn off the computer, the phone connection ends too. It reconnects when the computer wakes from sleep.
  • To use it in a new conversation next time, type /remote-control again.
  • Tired of typing it? In the computer app, go to Settings → Code and turn on Connect new sessions to Remote Control so new conversations connect automatically. (Best once you're comfortable.)

steps.title: 🎉 Phone practice done! What you learned
steps.html:
Now you can give the Claude on your computer jobs from your phone, even when you're out.

PhoneremoteClaude Code on your computerwith permissionComputer files

Three things to remember

  1. /remote-control on the computer → open the green-dot conversation in Code on the phone
  2. Your files are on the computer, so the computer and app must stay on.
  3. Allowing on the phone changes files on the computer. Always read the permission card before tapping.

Try it like this

On your commute, hand off things as they come to mind, like "tidy up my meeting notes" or "add this to my to-do list", and they'll be done on your computer when you get back.
